definition: A schedule used by partnerships and S corporations to report income and deductible expenses from rental real estate activities, including net income or loss from rental properties that flow through from partnerships, estates, or trusts.

includes.text: Reports rental real estate income and expenses for multiple properties with separate columns for each property
includes.quote: For each property in column (a), enter the street address

includes.text: Requires specification of property type using standardized codes
includes.quote: Specify the type of property by entering one of the following codes in column (b)

includes.text: Includes depreciation deduction calculations for rental property

excludes.text: Does not report supplemental income and loss from other sources like partnerships, S corporations, estates, trusts, and REITs
excludes.quote: Income or deductions from a trade or business activity or a rental activity other than rental real estate

excludes.text: Does not report mortgage interest statements issued to borrowers
Does not report interest and ordinary dividends from investments

discriminators.text: Reports only rental real estate activities and expenses; the sibling reports supplemental income and loss from partnerships, S corporations, estates, trusts, and other pass-through entities
discriminators.quote: Partnerships and S corporations use Form 8825 to report income and deductible expenses from rental real estate activities

discriminators.text: Reports rental property income and expenses for the entity; the sibling is a statement of mortgage interest paid by individual borrowers
discriminators.quote: For each property in column (a), enter the street address, city or town, and ZIP code

discriminators.text: Reports rental real estate income and expenses; the sibling reports interest and ordinary dividend income from investments
discriminators.quote: Rental real estate income and expenses of a partnership or an S corporation
